verdict.rationale: Typesense's ranking-and-relevance guide has a section titled "Text Match Score & Type", which suggests a per-result text-match score is documented and can be inspected. The pack contains only that heading, with no detail on how scores are returned or explained. missing for 10: evidence that per-result scores appear in search responses, any per-factor ranking explanation or debug output, documentation depth beyond a section title, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can inspect ranking scores or explanations to understand exactly why a result ranked where it did
